Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated refraction with reflection and selected “B) mirrors,” citing incidental refraction in a mirror’s glass substrate, whereas the correct “best example” of refraction is eyeglass lenses (“A”). The Planner also prematurely declared TASK_COMPLETE without engaging any specialist as instructed, preventing validation and correction of the conceptual error.
